title: Automated evidence pipeline for access, residency, and retention controls
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: build an automated evidence pipeline that ties RBAC grants, SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning events, and data residency/retention configurations into auditor-ready artifacts. Scope: (1) capture time-series of role assignments and SCIM provisioning events for orgs with residency requirements; (2) snapshot active retention policies per tenant and map to exported data locations; (3) surface periodic access review results and remediation actions as verifiable evidence; (4) export longitudinal 'evidence bundles' suitable for external auditors and internal compliance teams. Out of scope: full legal packaging and notarization; downstream archival retention enforcement (handled by retention service).
acceptance_criteria: System ingests SCIM delta events and SAML SSO assertions and records them to immutable event store within 5 minutes of occurrence
RBAC change artifacts include actor, timestamp, target resource, previous role, new role, and justification (if provided)
Evidence bundles can be generated per-tenant for any 90-day window and include: access timeline, active retention policy snapshots, residency mappings, and periodic review logs
Automated periodic access review job runs can be scheduled by org and their results stored as verifiable artifacts with reviewer IDs and remediation status
Exports support both human-readable PDF and machine-readable JSONL formats and are discoverable via Console and API with RBAC-protected endpoints

End-to-end demo: compliance team can produce an evidence bundle for tenant 'EU-CorpA' including residency constraints and show that a deprovisioning action occurred as captured by SCIM within the requested window
tasks: Design immutable event schema for access events and residency changes (include SCIM and SAML mapping)
Extend ingestion pipeline to tag events with tenant residency and retention profile
Implement periodic access review worker and UI hooks in Console for reviewer assignment and remediation tracking
Build evidence bundle generator service with PDF and JSONL exporters
Add API endpoint and Console page to request and stream evidence bundles with throttling and audit logs
End-to-end integration tests with sample SSO provider and SCIM provisioning simulator
Load test event retention and bundle generation for 10k tenants with 12-month histories

audit_steps: Step 1: Query evidence API for tenant and date range to retrieve JSONL bundle
Step 2: Verify event timeline contains SCIM provisioning events and SAML login assertions with matching timestamps
Step 3: Validate retention policy snapshots against retention-service outputs for the same timestamps
Step 4: Confirm access review entries include reviewer IDs, comments, and remediation actions
Step 5: Cross-check that exported artifact signatures match platform signing key recorded in key-management service
notes_and_risks: Risk: Scalability of on-demand PDF generation for long windows — mitigated via split generation (streaming JSONL plus async PDF job) and pre-warming for regulated tenants
Risk: SCIM/SAML payload completeness across customer adapters — mitigation: provide SCIM simulator for customers and document required headers; ENG-31112 created for bridge hardening
Decision: Use append-only tenant partitions in event store rather than immutable files for faster queryability; will add signed snapshot export to satisfy audit immutability requirements
Follow-up: Coordinate with Legal for evidence retention policy (how long bundles must be kept) and with Customer Success for tenant opt-in communication
demo_notes: Prepare demo showing EU tenant evidence bundle. Walk through: SSO login, SCIM deprovision, policy change, run access review, then generate and download bundle. Highlight signed verification headers.
